column6: The @fsux{gakkul} vat, the @fsux{gakkul} vat! The @fsux{gakkul} vat, the @fsux{lamsare} vat! The @fsux{gakkul} vat, which puts us in a happy mood! The @fsux{lamsare} vat, which makes the heart rejoice! The @fsux{ugurbal} jar, glory of the house! The @fsux{šaggub} jar, filled with beer! The @fsux{amam} jar, which carries the beer from the @fsux{lamsare} vat! The troughs made with @fsux{bur} grass and the pails for kneading the dough! All the beautiful vessels are ready on their pot stands!

May the heart of your god be well disposed towards you! Let the eye of the @fsux{gakkul} vat be our eye, and let the heart of the @fsux{gakkul} vat be our heart! What makes your heart feel wonderful in itself also makes our hearts feel wonderful in themselves! We are in a happy mood, our hearts are joyful! You have poured a libation over the fated brick, and you have laid the foundations in peace and prosperity -- now may @wDN{Ninkasi} dwell with you! She should pour beer and wine for you! Let the pouring of the sweet liquor resound pleasantly for you!

In the troughs made with @fsux{bur} grass, there is sweet beer. I will have the cupbearers, the boys and the brewers stand by. As I spin around the lake of beer, while feeling wonderful, feeling wonderful, while drinking beer, in a blissful mood, while drinking alcohol and feeling exhilarated, with joy in the heart and a contented liver -- my heart is a heart filled with joy! I clothe my contented liver in a garment fit for a queen! The heart of @wDN{Inana} is happy once again; the heart of @wDN{Inana} is happy once again!
